SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CARDTAG_SCRIPT.title: Script
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CARDTAG_SCRIPT.descript: A special kind of Power. Your [gold]activation limit[/gold] for Scripts is 1 by default, so activating a new Script [red]ends[/red] the old one.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CARDTAG_BURNING.title: Burning
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRIPT.title: Script
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRIPT.descript: A special kind of Power. Your [gold]activation limit[/gold] for Scripts is 1 by default, so activating a new Script [red]ends[/red] the old one.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRIPT_COLLECTI:
All Scripts activated during the current combat are recorded in your [gold]Script Collection[/gold].
If it contains at least four kinds of Script, your [gold]activation limit[/gold] +1.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_DOOM_KILL_THRES: That enemy's HP minus its [gold]Poison[/gold], [gold]Burning[/gold], and [gold]Doom[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_MULTI_TARGET.de: Cards that target [gold]ALL enemies[/gold], [gold]ALL players[/gold], or [gold][blue]multiple[/blue] random enemies[/gold] are [gold]Multi-target[/gold] cards.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_ENVIRONMENTAL.d: This damage has no source and deals a fixed amount.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_PIERCING_DAMAGE: Ignores [gold]Block[/gold] and specific target-side damage reduction, damage caps, and HP-loss caps. Consumable defenses bypassed this way do not lose stacks.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRY.title: Scry
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRY.descriptio: Look at the top cards of your draw pile, then discard any number of them.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_COUNTS_AS_PLAYE: Play a card that doesn't exist. It resolves normally.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_VARIOUS_STRIKE_: Cards with "Strike" in their name are called [gold]Strike Cards[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_VARIOUS_DEFEND_: Cards with "Defend" in their name are called [gold]Defend Cards[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_FIT.title: Fit
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_FIT.description: Whenever this would be shuffled into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], place it on the top instead.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_WAR_FEEDS_WAR.d:
At the end of Elite or Boss combats, if you played at least one card with this name this combat, drop one additional card with this name.
(If you played an upgraded card with this name, the reward is also upgraded.)
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_WAR_FEEDS_WAR.c: At the end of Elite or Boss combats, if you played at least one [gold]{CardName}[/gold] this combat, drop one additional [gold]{CardName}[/gold].
Due to [gold]Eunuch[/gold], this card has [gold]Ethereal[/gold] until it is played.
Due to [gold]Eunuch[/gold], this card has [gold]{DisplayedKeyword}[/gold] until it is played.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_CHARGE.title: Charge
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_CHARGE.descript: If this card is in your Hand, its [gold]Charge[/gold] effect triggers when the conditions are met. The effect is reset after this card is played.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_ENTHRALLED.desc: If this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], you must play cards with [gold]Enthralled[/gold] first.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_WRAP.title: Wrap
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_WRAP.descriptio: When you play this card, if you have an active [gold]Script[/gold] Power, end one Script and resolve the Wrap effect. If multiple Scripts are active, choose one.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_STRONG_MONSTER_:
The first few normal monster encounters in each Act only use weaker monster combinations: the first [blue]three[/blue] in Act 1, and the first [blue]two[/blue] in Acts 2 and 3.
Later normal monster encounters begin using stronger combinations—these are [gold]Strong Monster Encounters[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SLIGHT_REVISION:
You can right-click this card while it is in your Hand to transform it into a specific other card.
Note: This operation is usually irreversible for the rest of this combat.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SUPREME_GENERAL: While a card with [gold]Supreme General[/gold] is resolving, other Attack cards it automatically plays are treated as having received its [gold]Vigor[/gold] bonus.
While a card with [gold]Supreme General[/gold] is resolving, other Attack cards it automatically plays are treated as having received its [gold]Vigor[/gold]{DrunkenMightOr} bonus.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_FAMILY.title: Family
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_FAMILY.descript: When its [gold]play rate[/gold] is needed, this card's [gold]play rate[/gold] is treated as [blue]100%[/blue].
If this Script is already in your [gold]Script Collection[/gold], playing its corresponding Script card again upgrades this Script.
If this Script is already in your [gold]Script Collection[/gold], playing [gold]{SourceCardName}[/gold] again [gold]upgrades[/gold] this Script.
